args.title: Improve toast notifications for accessibility
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Modify the toast notifications to use 'aria-live="assertive"' for error toasts to ensure they are announced immediately by screen readers. Additionally, change the behavior so that error toasts do not auto-dismiss before the user acknowledges them.

label: feature
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The 'Toast.tsx' file defines toast notifications with a role of 'status' and 'aria-live' set to 'polite', making screen readers wait to announce them. An 'AUTO_DISMISS_MS' constant is set to 5000 milliseconds, causing the toast to auto-dismiss after 5 seconds. Error toasts should likely use 'aria-live="assertive"' for immediate announcement and should not auto-dismiss before user acknowledgment.
